fields.en: All life is yoga. Sri Aurobindo.
fields.hr: All life is yoga. Sri Aurobindo.

fields.en: The few houses at the shore. This is the whole of the built landscape here, and it is meant to stay that way.
fields.hr: Ono malo kuća uz obalu. To je cijeli izgrađeni krajolik ovdje i namjera je da tako i ostane.

fields.en: Auroville runs free progress schools, where a child follows their own interest and pace rather than a fixed grade. A working landscape is a good place for that. Children come with their families, and there is real work here they can do at their own size.
fields.hr: U Auroville rade free progress škole, gdje dijete prati vlastiti interes i ritam umjesto zadanog razreda. Radni krajolik je dobro mjesto za to. Djeca dolaze s obitelji, a ovdje ima stvarnog posla koji mogu raditi u svojoj mjeri.

fields.en: Work starts at first light, while the stone is still cool. The middle of the day belongs to the sea.
fields.hr: Posao počinje u prvo svjetlo, dok je kamen još hladan. Sredina dana pripada moru.

fields.en: Work exchanged for food and accommodation, listed on Workaway and WWOOF. Accommodation is basic: compost toilet, outdoor kitchen, simple shelter, no mains water. The work is physical, hot and slow. Anyone who wants comfort should read that sentence twice.
fields.hr: Rad u zamjenu za hranu i smještaj, oglašeno na Workaway i WWOOF. Smještaj je osnovan: kompostni zahod, vanjska kuhinja, jednostavno sklonište, bez vodovoda. Posao je fizički, vruć i spor. Tko traži udobnost, neka tu rečenicu pročita dvaput.
